data.name: Damayanti
data.gender_notes: Damayanti is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root dam, 'to subdue' — Damayantī. Its root is Sanskrit dam (दम्). Damayanti, heroine of the Mahabharata's Nala-Damayanti story. Damayanti is a Sanskrit name meaning “Subduing; a heroine's name”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Damayanti expresses “Subduing; a heroine's name”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root dam, 'to subdue' — Damayantī.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Damayanti total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

vedic_reference.note: Damayanti is the name of a princess in the Indian epic Mahabharata. She was known for her beauty, virtue, and intelligence. She married Nakula, one of the five Pandava brothers.
